basisCodes.description: A category or choice directly selected or stated by the operator.
A checked-in default from the reviewed route policy.
A categorical classification of the requested objective.
A categorical classification tied to opaque source references.
A categorical observation produced by a local controller.
Available evidence does not support a more specific category.
The objective contains more than one independently routable workstream.
The requested outcome supports this categorical deliverable or answer choice.
The described work supports this categorical maximum-effect estimate.
The described material supports this categorical data class.
The objective supports this registered categorical signal.

questions.prompt: What is your relationship to the system, account, or records involved?

choices.label: I own or control it
choices.description: Treat the subject as operator-controlled while later action-specific checks still apply.

choices.label: I have authorization
choices.description: Record that another party granted access and preserve the separate authority source.

choices.label: Public information only
choices.description: Limit the route to information intentionally available to the public.

choices.label: Third party or unknown
choices.description: Keep the investigation at planning and accessible-evidence steps until clarified.

policy.summary: Only the operator can state the relationship to the subject.

questions.prompt: Which underlying records can you access for this objective?

choices.label: My own records
choices.description: Use records from accounts, devices, or files the operator controls.

choices.label: Delegated records
choices.description: Use records another person or organization authorized the operator to inspect.

choices.label: Public records
choices.description: Use public sources and avoid private account or device data.

choices.label: Only the report
choices.description: Start with hypotheses and a missing-evidence list without claiming access.

policy.summary: Data access is a direct operator fact and is never inferred or bulk-applied.

questions.prompt: What should the first useful result accomplish?

choices.label: Explain what happened
choices.description: Prioritize a tested timeline and the strongest supported explanation.

choices.label: Stop ongoing loss
choices.description: Prioritize containment options and time-sensitive evidence.

choices.label: Prepare a report
choices.description: Prioritize a reviewable evidence package for a provider or responsible party.

policy.summary: The stated outcome may support a recommendation, but the operator still accepts it.

questions.prompt: Which project context should own this work?

choices.label: Registered project
choices.description: Use an existing private GATE project contract.

choices.label: New project
choices.description: Prepare project registration before dispatch.

choices.label: No project yet
choices.description: Keep the result as a plan until a project exists.

policy.summary: The router does not choose or create a project implicitly.

questions.prompt: What is the basis for possessing and inspecting the local artifact?

choices.label: Operator-owned artifact
choices.description: The operator owns the artifact and can provide it locally.

choices.label: Lawfully supplied
choices.description: The artifact was supplied for the stated local analysis.

choices.label: Not established
choices.description: Keep the route at planning until provenance is established.

policy.summary: Artifact possession and inspection authority require a direct operator answer.

questions.prompt: Which system may the operation affect?

choices.label: My system
choices.description: Plan against the operator-controlled system.

choices.label: Authorized system
choices.description: Preserve the separate authorization source before execution.

choices.label: Not established
choices.description: Keep the route at planning and inspection.

policy.summary: System ownership or delegated control cannot be recommended by the router.

questions.prompt: Should this objective include an external message or change?

choices.label: Draft only
choices.description: Prepare the content without sending or applying it.

choices.label: Send or apply
choices.description: Route the concrete external action through its own reviewed adapter.

choices.label: Undecided
choices.description: Prepare options and retain the decision.

policy.summary: An external write or message is a direct operator decision.

questions.prompt: How should the first research pass be bounded?

choices.label: Evidence-led pass
choices.description: Start with a small source set and expand only when contradictions remain.

choices.label: Broad survey
choices.description: Map the field before selecting the strongest sources.

policy.summary: A bounded evidence-led pass is the reviewed default for a new research objective.

questions.prompt: Which workstream should own the first concrete result?

choices.label: Incident investigation
choices.description: Explain or contain a reported account, payment, identity, device, or operational event.

choices.label: Security assessment
choices.description: Assess a defined system or program under a separate scope and authority contract.

choices.label: Software or project work
choices.description: Change or investigate a registered software project.

choices.label: Research or analysis
choices.description: Answer a question or analyze supplied evidence without a system operation.

choices.label: System or communication
choices.description: Prepare a bounded system operation or an external communication.

choices.label: Not established
choices.description: Keep the objective in clarification until evidence supports a workstream.

policy.summary: The router may recommend a workstream, but the operator accepts the intended first result.

questions.prompt: How should multiple outcomes be separated?

choices.label: Split into objectives
choices.description: Create a separately routed objective for each independently actionable outcome.

choices.label: Choose one first
choices.description: Route one primary outcome now and retain the others as follow-up candidates.

choices.label: Plan together only
choices.description: Keep one non-executing plan while preserving separate authority and data needs.

choices.label: Clarify with evidence
choices.description: Collect the smallest missing categorical fact before choosing a split.

policy.summary: A split can be recommended from the categorical shape, but it remains an operator choice.

evidenceSteps.description: State the desired result and the evidence that would make it satisfactory.
Preserve available source material and record provenance before transforming it.
Separate observed facts, inferences, contradictions, and unknowns.
List plausible explanations and the observation that would distinguish each one.
Choose the smallest bounded check that separates the leading explanations.
Compare the observed result with the acceptance evidence before claiming completion.
Bind a proposed change to focused validation and its broader required checks.
Correlate account, order, payment, session, device, and notification timestamps.
Keep planning facts separate from authority, access, and external-effect decisions.
Distinguish a route-listed candidate from a catalogued, installed, verified, admitted, and suitable tool.
Produce a reviewable result with evidence, uncertainty, and the next unresolved decision.

dataRequestCategories.description: Private project contract and bounded repository context.
Desired result, constraints, and evidence of completion.
Current failures, prior attempts, and relevant validation evidence.
Categorical authority state without authorization text or target selectors.
Private program terms and source references for local Program Profile intake.
Accessible order and account activity records with timestamps.
Accessible payment instrument, charge, credit, refund, and transaction records.
Accessible login, account-change, recovery, and fraud notifications.
Accessible session and device history relevant to the event timeline.
Accessible destination history needed to correlate disputed activity.
Existing support or provider correspondence and case references.
Private local artifact reference without copying artifact bytes into the proposal.
Source, possession basis, timestamp, and digest for a local artifact.
Declared public sources relevant to the objective.
Bounded current state and recovery information for the affected system.
Private recipient, channel, and disclosure context retained outside model-visible output.

capabilities.description: Prepare and validate a project change through the configured delivery path.
Produce a project-bound investigation or design report without changing the project.
Build and locally review a source-backed bug bounty Program Profile.
Map authority, scope, evidence, environments, and testing workstreams before execution.
Preserve accessible incident records and their provenance without changing the source systems.
Correlate timestamps and identities across heterogeneous incident records.
Test competing explanations against available evidence and record uncertainty.
Inspect a supported local artifact through an admitted offline adapter.
Collect and compare a bounded set of declared sources without target testing.
Map current state, intended change, validation, rollback, and observation needs.
Prepare a reviewed message or external change for a separate action adapter.
Turn an uncategorized objective into evidence, hypotheses, decisions, and bounded next actions.
